speaker: Doctor
text: Has there been any change in his memory, ability to perform daily tasks, or recent headaches and vision changes? I would also like to request a neurological examination and an MRI of the brain to evaluate for structural causes. REQUEST TEST: MRI_Brain

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the MRI and DaTscan are normal, we must rule out metabolic or endocrine causes for these behavioral changes and weight gain, such as hypothyroidism or diabetes. REQUEST TEST: TSH; REQUEST TEST: HbA1c

speaker: Doctor
text: With structural, metabolic, and typical parkinsonian causes ruled out, this clinical picture of early behavioral disinhibition and hyperphagia is classic for behavioral variant Frontotemporal Dementia.
